title: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Three Dreams, Three Truths

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young man with a whip of light magic who is courting Amalia and is haunted by dreams from Lorwyn after buying meadowsweet.

entities.name: Amalia
entities.description: Kellan's partner, an explorer who surveys and who keeps his dream journal.

entities.name: Annie
entities.description: Someone who taught Kellan a card trick.

entities.name: Morecote
entities.description: A proud scarred ash treefolk warrior who kills a faerie in anger and sacrifices himself against a giant.

entities.name: Erewaker
entities.description: A rowan treefolk apprentice of Sigric who carries the sapling to the veil and performs the Rising alone.

entities.name: Sigric
entities.description: An old elder treefolk and Erewaker's mentor, poisoned by faeries, who sacrifices his bark for the ritual.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: An ancient yew treefolk, born of the night, whom the treefolk hope to revive; Sigric and Erewaker tend a sapling of his.

entities.name: Yew sapling
entities.description: A yew sapling grafted on Sigric and carried by Erewaker, which takes its first breath at the Rising.

entities.name: Forget-Me-Not
entities.description: A faerie of the Deffroad Clique with forget-me-nots on her shoulders who helps poison Sigric and orchestrate the ritual's sabotage.

entities.name: Baby's Breath
entities.description: A faerie of the Deffroad Clique in a gown of baby's breath who taunts Morecote and helps poison Sigric.

entities.name: Meadowsweet
entities.description: A faerie of the Deffroad Clique with meadowsweet for hair who challenges Morecote to a duel and is crushed by him.

entities.name: Deffroad Clique
entities.description: A clique of three faeries who manipulate the treefolk's journey.

entities.name: Crescent relic
entities.description: A crescent-moon relic woven from Colfenor's branches that preserves its wearer's memory across the veil.

entities.name: Dawnglove
entities.description: A flower that grows near the silver water in the clearing past the aurora.

entities.name: Rising
entities.description: The ritual by which treefolk gain sentience; the trees hope to perform a new Rising to revive the yew.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane where the treefolk journey and the home of the dreams Kellan sees.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The night aspect that envelops Erewaker beyond the veil.

entities.name: Giant
entities.description: An unnamed giant woman whom the faeries harry awake and who attacks the treefolk.

events.summary: Kellan gives Amalia flowers called meadowsweet from Lorwyn and mentions dreaming of them.
events.quote: Would you believe I dreamt of these a couple of nights ago?

events.summary: Three treefolk, Morecote, Erewaker and Sigric, travel across Lorwyn to plant a yew sapling for a new Rising.
events.quote: We have a sacred duty to the yew trees.

events.summary: Three faeries taunt Morecote, calling him a failure, and challenge him to a duel.
events.quote: If you duel all of us at once and win, we'll tell you something.

events.summary: Morecote accepts and clears a field for the duel with the faeries.
events.quote: Come and test my mettle, then.

events.summary: Morecote crushes Meadowsweet in his grip while the other two faeries poison Sigric.
events.quote: Blood spills upon the white Meadowsweet and upon the bark of the ash tree.

events.summary: The faeries flee, remarking that yew grows best within a corpse.
events.quote: Yew grows best within a corpse.

events.summary: Kellan wakes from a dream of a rotting elder tree that screams like a human and writes down a woman's voice.
events.quote: And as the tree fell to the ground, it screamed .

events.summary: Sigric, weakened by poison, tells them they must pass a sleeping giant to reach the veil and rambles about Colfenor.
events.quote: It cannot grow where the sun warms its leaves.

events.summary: They spot Forget-Me-Not and Baby's Breath hovering near the giant's head, harrying her awake.
events.quote: All Erewaker can do is watch in horror as they harry the giant.

events.summary: Morecote tears the sapling from Sigric, hands it to Erewaker and stays to face the awakened giant.
events.quote: Morecote tears the sapling straight from Sigric's bark.

events.summary: The giant demands who woke her, seeking a new walking stick.
events.quote: So, which one of you will be my new walking stick?

events.summary: Sigric gives Erewaker a sheet of his bark to plant with the sapling and conjures vines to cover her escape as he and Morecote face the giant.
events.quote: with the last of his might he calls a wall of vines between them.

events.summary: Kellan awakens on the third night and finds forget-me-nots blooming from his tongue.
events.quote: Forget-me-nots bloom from his tongue.

events.summary: Erewaker crosses into Shadowmoor alone with the sapling, mocked by the faeries, and reaches the clearing with dawnglove.
events.quote: Dawnglove ahead. Her journey nearly to its end.

events.summary: Erewaker performs the Rising ritual in the clearing while the faeries heckle her.
events.quote: Once she walks round the clearing. Twice.

events.summary: The ritual seems to fail, and the faeries urge Erewaker to cast aside her relic.
events.quote: Is cast aside your relic.

events.summary: Erewaker lays down her relic and the sapling takes its first breath.
events.quote: The sapling takes their first breath.

events.summary: The faeries attack the relic and sapling, and an explosion of magic covers the clearing in dawnglove.
events.quote: Dawnglove grows like moss to cover all that it might.

events.summary: Erewaker realizes the faeries herded the treefolk to this grove and dies as roots pierce her, her sap falling on the mound.
events.quote: but they'd been herded, like dogs, to this grove the whole while. To death.

events.summary: Forget-Me-Not announces the Deffroad Clique's work is done as she dies fulfilling her purpose.
events.quote: What a delight it has been to be the Deffroad Clique,

events.summary: Kellan coughs up a black flower while Amalia reads the dream journal, and later sees a woman's face in the mirror.
events.quote: A woman's face where his should be, surrounded by black flowers, eyes flashing and smiling.

relations.note: Partners who banter and share dreams.
relations.quote: He wraps an arm around her waist; she touches his nose.
In all their long years as master and apprentice

relations.note: Morecote squeezes the faerie until it dies.
relations.quote: He squeezes and squeezes and squeezes.
While Morecote had been distracted, these two had gotten to Sigric.
What a delight it has been to be the Deffroad Clique,

relations.note: The relic was woven from cast-offs of Colfenor's branches by Sigric.
relations.quote: Woven from cast-offs of Colfenor's branches and infused with ancient magic

relations.note: Sigric acts for the yews' revival.
relations.quote: The yew cannot be permitted to die entirely.

relations.note: He sacrifices himself so she can escape with the sapling.
